participation.context: Sat at the scarred board and looked at what was set on it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the meat, the mustard, the crusts, and the pewter.

participation.context: Named the page, lent nothing, and left on the purse.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Came uninvited, spent the room on Harvey, sang one verse, and paid a penny.
participation.name: Thomas Nashe

participation.context: Made Nashe pay for one cup, and told you to go before you lent him anything.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Got one verse, and refused a second.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Ate through the argument, and kept the fast outside the parlour.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Asked to fast from explanations, and stayed with the marrow.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Named tenpence a head, reported a winter without a purse-quarrel, and touched the table.
participation.name: John Heminges

relations.note: a penny received for one cup, and no tenpence, and no loan
relations.quote: I will write tenpence a head, and a penny received of Master Nashe, and nothing else.

story.body: You told Nashe he was the page, not the pedant and not the braggart. You saw a penny go down for one cup. You heard the winter called clear of a purse-quarrel. You said you were in pain, and you left close on nine.

relations.note: a penny received for one cup, and no tenpence, and no loan
relations.quote: I will write tenpence a head, and a penny received of Master Nashe, and nothing else.

title: Told Nashe he was the page

participation.context: Spoke the two sums, refused the loan, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You repeated the tenpence and the penny, said the page would hold, and stopped. You did not go back down.

title: Said the page would hold, and stopped
